title: Sign out of one Mac only
steps: Sign in to the same test account on two Macs with iCloud Keychain on and OPENHUMAN_SAFE_MODE=read-only
On one Mac choose Settings › Accounts › Sign out… › Sign out of this Mac
Quit and reopen Mail on the other Mac
expected: While the account's sign-in is shared (Settings › Accounts says so), the dialog offers Sign out and remove from iCloud Keychain as a separate button; after Sign out of this Mac the other Mac stays signed in. On a build that can't sync, the dialog offers only Sign out of this Mac.
